tagline: Hong Kong胶片相机，1991 年发布
description: Hong Kong于1991年推出的胶片相机。

specs.英文简介: The Revue 300 TW is a simple plastic camera for 110 film, made in Hong Kong and distributed by Foto-Quelle in Germany from 1991.It has a single shutter speed and no aperture control.A sliding switch at the bottom of the camera body moves an extra lens in front of the fixed focus lens creating a moderate tele lens effect.
